name: LOTO - Authorized Employee
about: Applies energy-control locks and tags and performs servicing under the LOTO procedure. Includes a hands-on demonstration.

name: LOTO - Affected Employee
about: Understands the purpose of lockout/tagout, never operates locked-out equipment and never removes a lock.

name: Station Competency Sign-Off
about: Shown to work a station on their own: setup, service, closing and the station checklists.
